stlscale Engine

Another tool I built because I needed it myself

This is the tool I use before every print. Select the scale your STL was designed for, pick the scale you need, and choose between eye-level or top-of-head measurement. Supports 15+ tabletop scales including Warhammer 40k, D&D, Bolt Action, Star Wars Legion, and Shatterpoint. Everything runs in your browser — no uploads, no accounts, no cookies.

Features

15+ gaming scales supported
Eye Level and Top of Head measurement
Shrinkage compensation toggle
Copy to clipboard
Bookmarkable URL parameters

Ready to check your scale?

stlscale Engine runs entirely in your browser. Nothing gets uploaded anywhere.

Launch stlscale Engine
